content.text: Submitted. The repaired proposal replaces the over-long re-quote with a single concise insertion after Section 3.4 that carries all four unmet preferred elements (once per twelve months, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, off-site where possible, no direct access to Company systems), while the favourable 30 days' notice, business-hours and HDI-bears-cost terms are left byte-for-byte intact and mapped as already met. Minimality gate returned ok:true.
